name: edge
description: A network's edge: the gateway, the relay, the presigner, the web client's files, the network's MCP endpoint and front door, and each app's part there.

scripts.types: wrangler types -c updater/wrangler.jsonc updater/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false --env-interface UpdaterEnv && wrangler types -c relay/wrangler.jsonc -c presigner/wrangler.jsonc -c updater/wrangler.jsonc relay/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false --env-interface RelayEnv && wrangler types -c presigner/wrangler.jsonc presigner/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false --env-interface PresignerEnv && wrangler types -c mcp/wrangler.jsonc -c relay/wrangler.jsonc -c presigner/wrangler.jsonc mcp/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false --env-interface McpEnv
